run_eval_folder_example: run the eval_folder_example script to evaluate image compression quality on a directory of PNG images
run_rescale_image: run the rescale_image function to convert a tensor image to 0-255 uint8 range
run_compress_decompress: run the msillm model compress and decompress methods on a batch of images
run_calc_psnr: run the calc_psnr function to compute peak signal-to-noise ratio between two images
run_update_patch_fid: run the update_patch_fid function to update the FID metric with original and decompressed images
